fields.notes: Block-level peripheral spec does not include PDK / timing constraints; these are deferred to the SoC integration spec.
timing_constraints: HS400 DDR: data valid relative to the device-sourced Data Strobe (DS) rather than CLK.

io_constraints: VCCQ 1.8V or 1.2V for HS200/HS400; 3.3V allowed for legacy modes.
Selectable driver strength to match board loading.
